dhubServices.name: Split AC Installation & Physical Issues
dhubServices.description: Split AC installation involves mounting the indoor and outdoor units in suitable locations, connecting refrigerant pipes, electrical wiring, and the drainage line, and ensuring the system  operates efficiently.  The indoor unit is fixed on a solid wall with a slight tilt for proper water drainage, while a hole is drilled for passing copper pipes, the drain hose, and cables. The outdoor unit is placed on a flat surface or securely mounted on brackets with enough clearance for ventilation and reduced vibration. Copper refrigerant pipes are connected carefully to avoid kinks or leaks and insulated to prevent condensation. After connecting power and communication cables, the technician vacuum-pumps the refrigerant circuit to remove air and moisture before testing the system.
